# Seaforge Inc.

Seaforge Inc. is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Seaforge develops offshore data-center vessels engineered to deliver reliable, high-density compute capacity where traditional infrastructure cannot be deployed. Seaforge Inc. employs 1 person, founded in 2025.

## About

Seaforge develops offshore data-center vessels engineered to deliver reliable, high-density compute capacity where traditional infrastructure cannot. As global power constraints, interconnection delays, and regulatory friction slow the deployment of new land-based facilities, organizations face increasing difficulty expanding their digital and analytical capabilities.

Seaforge addresses these bottlenecks by shifting critical compute offshore. Each vessel integrates liquid-cooled data halls, onboard power generation, and seawater-based heat rejection, enabling large-scale deployments without dependence on constrained utility grids, freshwater resources, or long permitting cycles.

Built to government-grade security standards and designed for predictable, location-flexible deployment, Seaforge provides a scalable path to expanding national and enterprise compute capacity while reducing environmental impact and improving infrastructure resilience.

Kinetics and Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Sign MOU to Develop World's First Integrated Floating Data Center Platform | Press Release | Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd.

July 07, 2025

# Kinetics and Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Sign MOU to Develop World's First Integrated Floating Data Center Platform

Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd. (MOL), one of the world's leading shipping companies, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Kinetics, the energy transition initiative of global floating power leader Karpowership, to jointly develop a next-generation Floating Data Center platform.

CG rendering of powership and offshore data center

Photo of powership (quote: https://karpowership.com/)

Under the MOU, the two companies will collaborate on the design, construction and deployment of a state-of-the-art data center hosted on a retrofitted vessel. The facility will be supplied with uninterrupted, dedicated power from a range of flexible sources, including Powerships developed by Karpowership, as well as options to integrate land-based grids, onshore solar farms, offshore wind, or other power generation solutions depending on project location and client requirements. Karpowership, a pioneer in integrated floating power solutions, brings over two decades of operational experience with more than 10,000 MW of installed capacity across 19 countries.

MOL and Hitachi Launch Initiative to Convert Used Ships into Floating Data Centers : Hitachi Global

Mar 30, 2026

# MOL and Hitachi Launch Initiative to Convert Used Ships into Floating Data Centers

~ Providing Digital Infrastructure to Meet Growing AI Demand ~

Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd.

Hitachi, Ltd.

Hitachi Systems, Ltd.

Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd. (MOL; President & CEO: Takeshi Hashimoto; Headquarters: Minato-ku, Tokyo), Hitachi, Ltd. (Hitachi; President & CEO: Toshiaki Tokunaga; Headquarters: Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo), and Hitachi Systems, Ltd. (Hitachi Systems; President & CEO : Takehiko Watanabe; Head Office: Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo) today announced the signing of a Memorandum Of Understanding (MOU) for the development, operation, and commercialization of a “Floating Data Center (FDC) converted from a second-hand vessel.” (Note) Based on this MOU, the companies will conduct demand verification, review basic specifications and operational procedures, and carry out feasibility studies for commercialization of an FDC, with a view to commencing operations in 2027 or later. The project will focus primarily on Japan, where the Hitachi Group already has operational experience in land-based data centers, as well as Malaysia and the United States, where there are proven track records in providing services related to land-based data centers.
